# What will transactional email cost at your send volume, and who is cheapest?

> Enter your monthly send volume and see what Resend, Postmark, SendGrid, Mailgun, Amazon SES and Brevo charge, the 12-month spend under your growth rate, and the volume where the cheapest provider changes. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
